patch_description:
The current program has 84 parameters with poor validation accuracy (0.55). The prior programs achieved better results with 60-66 parameters. The issue is that the current spec has redundant entanglement layers (both CZ and CRX on the same edges, plus duplicate hub connections).

Instead of upload-indexed deltas (which require code changes outside EVOLVE-BLOCK), I'll simplify the architecture:
1. Remove the duplicate CZ + CRX ring gates (keep only CRX which is parametrized)
2. Remove the duplicate hub-edge CRX gates (keep only one set with shared parameter)
3. Keep the single-qubit rotations with symmetry-based sharing
4. This reduces parameters from 84 to ~54-60 while maintaining expressivity

This should:
- Reduce parameter count closer to the successful prior programs
- Improve validation accuracy by reducing overfitting
- Maintain good generalization with fewer parameters
- Keep the hierarchical structure that worked well before
